name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.rtx5090-2gpu-tp2-256k-fp8kv-dflash2
notes: Qwen3.8-27B w4a4 (RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4) on 2x RTX 5090 at TP=2, copied directly from the 1x RTX 5090 profile. Engine configuration remains fp8_e4m3 KV, DFlash2 with syvai W4A16 drafter n=7, 262144 context, max_num_batched_tokens 16384, prefix caching, multimodal, and gpu_memory_utilization 0.90. Only model/served naming and tensor_parallel_size=2 differ. Capacity estimate based on measured TP2 PRO 6000 allocation: ~11.4 GiB weight shard + ~2.9 GiB activation/CUDAGraph overhead per GPU, leaving roughly 14 GiB KV per 32 GB GPU at 0.90. At the measured TP2 fp8-KV density (~23-24 KiB/token/GPU), expected aggregate KV pool is ~600k tokens, comfortably above 262144. Mandatory post-launch checks: fresh CUDA GEMM before vLLM trust, power caps, and nvidia-smi topo; reject SYS topology.
